facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog post 'Why you need fresh customer profiles (and how to build them!)' was published on July 7, 2021.
StackAdapt states that the majority of caregivers of babies and toddlers are millennials, so those caregivers can be reached through mobile and connected TV.
facts.quote: since the majority of caregivers of babies and toddlers are millennials, it’s safe to assume that you can reach them through mobile and connected TV.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that millennials are enthusiastically adopting digital audio, while Gen X is found watching connected TV.
facts.quote: while millennials are enthusiastically adopting [digital audio]

facts.fact: StackAdapt lists the demographic aspects to consider when creating a customer profile as age, income level, family size, occupation, education level and marital status.
facts.quote: Demographic aspects to think about include age, income level, family size, occupation, education level and marital status.

facts.fact: StackAdapt defines a customer profile as factual information about the demographics and buying behaviors of a target audience.
facts.quote: Customer profiles provide factual information about the demographics and buying behaviors of your target audience.
